insight: Raised a $4M seed in 2025 backed by Lux Capital and the founders of Replit, Hugging Face, and Modal.
name: Phonic
tagline: Speech-to-speech platform for reliable voice agents.
description: Phonic is a platform for building production voice agents on its own end-to-end speech-to-speech models, rather than chaining separate speech-to-text, LLM, and text-to-speech stages. It targets sub-300ms latency for natural turn-taking and reliable tool calling, and bundles evaluation, session records, and real-time observability to surface failure points. Aimed at enterprises, it offers cloud API access plus containerized deployment in your own environment.

modelSupport.notes: Built on Phonic's own speech-to-speech audio foundation models.

edge: Runs one proprietary speech-to-speech model at sub-300ms latency instead of an STT→LLM→TTS chain, with eval and observability built in for voice agents.
pros: Reliable tool calling for voice agents
